text: {"lessons":["My account has fluctuated without any trades, so I should not let one month’s gain or loss prompt an impulsive decision.","Selling 20 shares of Stock A at a gain realized a profit, but I cannot tell from one sale whether the timing was right; I should trade only for a clear portfolio reason.","These savings support my retirement, so I should favor manageable risk, retain cash for living needs, and avoid frequent trading or chasing short-term gains."]}
